lastText: GQGCOMPTE RENDUHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 1/5-2MANPOWER-4MUNITIONS-6ARMY MORALEVIII.1917The Conversation Nobody Was Allowed to HaveWith the army in open indiscipline and the Chamber told none of it, an approach is made. It is made from a country holding a line it can hold, with ten departments still under occupation, which is the whole difficulty: any terms available now leave some of France where it currently is. That is why this was never seriously attempted. It is not that nobody thought of it.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. No French government of 1917 could have signed terms leaving the occupied departments in German hands and survived the signing.Return to file
